_doc: THE SHARED PROTOCOL TEST CASES of libs:ai: the OpenAI-style wire both families speak, as data. libs:ai's AiProtocolTest (Kotlin, run by the Gradle unit phase of every consumer that carries it) and Cloud Code's test/chat.mjs (JS, run by test-chat.sh) feed the same cases to their own implementations and must agree: `sse` = a streamed answer cut at arbitrary chunk boundaries; `whole` = a non-streamed answer or an error; `request` = what a backend puts on the wire. A case is added here once and both sides fail until both implement it.

sse.name: deltas are joined across chunk boundaries
a keep-alive comment and a partial event are ignored
an error event is reported with its message
a stream that has not ended is not done

whole.name: an error object wins over a 200
a gateway error status carries the error message
an error status with no message says its code
a non-JSON error body is cut and prefixed with its code
a gateway message shape is read
url citations are collected once each

request.name: a gateway agent with a fixed model sends no model and names its mode
the gateway's openrouter mode sends the picked model
OpenRouter direct sends the picked model and asks the token from the caller
